headlines.title: US to Unveil Trump's 'Economic D-Day' Sanctions Against Iran
headlines.description: Americans are bracing for the potential impact on oil and gas prices as President Donald Trump prepares to unveil his “economic D-Day” sanctions on Iran. It comes as fallout from the administration’s intensifying trade war with Canada grows. NBC's Gabe Gutierrez reports and chief business correspondent Christine Romans joins TODAY with what both trade issues will mean for the American consumer.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy trial resumes after defense rests its case
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three young children, resumes in Massachusetts after the defense rested its case.

headlines.title: Trump threatens to raise auto, truck and metal tariffs on Canada
headlines.description: In a post on social media, President Trump threatened to raise tariffs on Canada for imported cars, trucks, automobile parts and steel after Canadian Prime Minister Carney said he would retaliate economically. NBC News' Gabe Gutierrez reports from the White House on the escalating trade tensions.

headlines.title: Father of sailor aboard USS Lincoln detained by immigration authorities, family says
headlines.description: Joshua Aviles said he has been “fighting for a country that has given me everything,” only to learn his father had been detained.

headlines.title: Massive Hawk Fire Near Reno Prompts Thousands of Evacuations
headlines.description: A fast-moving wildfire in western Nevada is prompting a state of emergency and tens of thousands of evacuations near Reno, as the National Guard is called in to help. It comes as the extreme heat gripping much of the country enters a second week. NBC's Steve Patterson reports and TODAY’s Dylan Dreyer tracks the forecast.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: As Ukraine’s allies gather for big anniversary, one key backer is absent
headlines.description: Leaders of Ukraine’s international allies on Monday marked 35 years since the country broke away from the Soviet Union to become an independent nation.

headlines.title: Trump hits back at Carney, threatens to hike auto, truck, metals tariffs to 50%
headlines.description: President Donald Trump hit back at Canada’s Mark Carney in an escalating trade war by threatening a 50% tariff on cars, trucks and steel from Canada.

headlines.title: Send in your questions on AI and robotics for Janis Mackey Frayer
headlines.description: NBC News’ correspondent, who has spent years in China, will answer reader questions in a Q&A for subscribers on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Dan Sullivan endorses Dan Sullivan to beat Dan Sullivan in perplexing Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: A third Dan Sullivan — a former Anchorage mayor — has weighed in on the competitive Senate race, endorsing Sen. Dan S. Sullivan over former teacher Dan J. Sullivan.

headlines.title: Should you stop using your hands to apply your skin care? We asked a dermatologist
headlines.description: Wondering if using your fingers to apply skin care spreads bacteria? A board-certified dermatologist explains, plus the best hands-free skin care products to try.

headlines.title: This popular rolling duffel bag ‘holds 4 days of clothes for 3 people’ — it’s under $30 today
headlines.description: Looking for a duffel that packs a week’s worth of clothes? See why the Rockland Rolling Duffel Bag is a smart, budget-friendly pick for your next trip.
